textos.Colineal Franklin con horquillas: adapta: Franklin collinear with hairpins: it matches, but with little bandwidth and little gain.
textos.Colineal coaxial impresa: radia, pero la: Printed coaxial collinear: it radiates, but the FR4 losses eat the gain.
textos.Coloca la antena en un borde o esquina d: Put the antenna at an edge or corner of the board, with the radiator pointing outwards, and far (≥ λ/10) from batteries, screens or metal parts.
textos.Como la F invertida pero con el brazo y: Like the inverted-F but with a wide arm and short-circuit (plates): more bandwidth and less sensitive to the ground. Not validated.
textos.Con IPEX el monopolo recto adaptó mal en: With IPEX the straight monopole matched poorly in simulation (−7 dB): the central pad transition is under review. It works well with SMA.
textos.Con alimentación directa, la Yagi solo a: With direct feed, the Yagi only matches if the reflector is moved away (~0.39 λ0), which lengthens the board. The tested version: straight elements, 2 directors, 7.2 dBi (2.4 GHz and 868 MHz).
textos.Con balun impreso: el boom (la tira de m: With printed balun: the boom (the ground strip under the line) is part of the balun; do not trim it or put copper at its sides.
textos.Con coaxial al centro: vivo al brazo der: With coax at the centre: live conductor to the right arm and braid to the left, and take the cable out perpendicular to the arms for at least λ/4 before bending it; a ferrite next to the solder joint stops the braid radiating.
textos.Con dipolo plegado ha salido radiando ha: With a folded dipole it has radiated backwards (F/B −3.6 dB) and with less gain (5.6 dBi). Use direct feed.
textos.Con elementos de Koch la Yagi ha salido: With Koch elements the Yagi has gone wrong in simulation (matches poorly and radiates more backwards than towards the directors). Use straight elements (iteration 0).
textos.Con los directores unidos al boom la fre: With the directors joined to the boom the frequency jumps between modes while tuning and the match is slightly worse than with separate directors.
textos.Con masa compacta el cable forma parte d: With a compact ground the cable becomes part of the antenna: measure with a ferrite on the coax 2–3 cm from the board and without touching the board.
textos.Con muchos tramos, la corriente decae ha: With many sections the current decays towards the tip and the gain barely grows.
textos.Con parásitos cerca, el dipolo baja a ~1: With parasitic elements nearby, the dipole drops to ~10–15 Ω: the transformer or the folding takes it to 50 Ω
textos.Con reflector el panel radia solo hacia: With a reflector the panel radiates only forwards. Without one it radiates from both faces (bidirectional), does not cancel a lower second band, and the gain drops about 3 dB.
textos.Con sobrelargo del {0:g} %: se ajusta pa: With an extra length of {0:g} %: it is tuned so that, uncut, it resonates at {1:.1f} MHz (cutting at the marks reaches {2:.1f} MHz).
textos.Con transformador λ/4: radia hacia delan: With λ/4 transformer: radiates forwards, but narrow band (~50 MHz) and efficiency ~55 %.
textos.Con {0} directores la Yagi gana poco por: With {0} directors the Yagi gains little per extra director (~0.5–1 dB) and the board grows a lot.
textos.Con «Bowtie de Sierpinski»: huecos trian: With «Sierpinski bowtie»: triangular holes in the arm; with «Arrowhead»: iteration of the curve (3 is a good starting point)
textos.Concentran la señal hacia un lado: para: They concentrate the signal to one side: for linking two distant points or a repeater pointing down a valley.
textos.Conecta la antena. Cada medida se guarda: Connect the antenna. Each measurement is saved in the design with its label; live mode repeats the measurement near the band while you cut or change the π network, without saving it.
textos.Conéctalo por USB. Solo se lee su estado: Connect it by USB. Only its status is read: its calibration and saved slots are not touched.

textos.Dipolo de media onda con brazos triangul: Half-wave dipole with triangular arms (or Sierpinski triangles): more bandwidth than the straight one and it tolerates εr detuning better. Omnidirectional (~2 dBi). With SMA and printed balun or coax at the centre.

textos.Esperando a que termine de cargar el mot: Waiting for the engine to finish loading…
textos.Este diseño aún no tiene simulación ni m: This design has no simulation or measurements yet.
textos.Este tipo solo se ha validado en simulac: This type has only been validated in simulation at 2.4 GHz: at other frequencies the estimate may be less accurate. Simulate it.
textos.Ferrita (o choke de λ/4) en el cable jun: Ferrite (or λ/4 choke) on the cable next to the connector: without it, the braid radiates and shifts the resonance and the pattern.
textos.Fija la impedancia: más separada, más im: Sets the impedance: further apart, higher impedance
textos.Forma de cada elemento: dipolo recto, bo: Shape of each element: straight dipole, bowtie (triangles) or Sierpinski bowtie. The bowtie tolerates frequency deviations better (more bandwidth).
textos.Forma de cada parche: rectangular o frac: Shape of each patch: rectangular or Minkowski fractal.
textos.Forma de la placa: rectangular o ajustad: Board shape: rectangular or fitted to the antenna (rounded corners, less FR4).
textos.Frecuencia cambiada: pulsa «Ajustar tama: Frequency changed: press «Resize to the frequency».
textos.GPS e Iridium emiten con polarización ci: GPS and Iridium transmit with circular polarisation and this antenna is linear: you lose ~3 dB. For good receive sensitivity you need a circularly polarised patch.
textos.GPU no disponible ({0}): se usa la CPU: GPU not available ({0}): the CPU is used
textos.Guarda el diseño (o haz una medida) para: Save the design (or make a measurement) to see its measurements and its simulation here.
textos.Guarda el diseño y exporta la placa de p: Saves the design and exports the KiCad test board, the footprint, the Gerbers for JLC (with drills) and the DXF to the design's «fabricacion» folder. It passes the KiCad DRC.
textos.Hilbert de orden 4 o más: hueco entre vu: Hilbert of order 4 or more: gap between turns is very small; check the manufacturing checks and JLC's tolerance.
textos.Hueco a cada lado de la línea en la ranu: Gap on each side of the line in the slot [mm]
textos.Hueco en cada cruce entre tramos (las ti: Gap at each crossing between sections (the strips cross with two vias).
textos.Hueco entre el parche y el parásito [mm]: Gap between the patch and the parasitic [mm]
textos.Hueco entre el parche y el parásito acop: Gap between the patch and the coupled parasitic. Less gap: more coupling and more bandwidth.
textos.Hueco entre la línea y el parche a cada: Gap between the line and the patch on each side of the slot.
textos.Hueco entre las dos ramas de cada horqui: Gap between the two branches of each hairpin.
textos.Hueco entre las dos tiras de la línea qu: Gap between the two strips of the line that feeds the dipole.
textos.Hueco entre los brazos en el centro, don: Gap between the arms at the centre, where the coax is soldered (coax feed).
textos.Hueco entre los dos brazos del adaptador: Gap between the two arms of the λ/4 adapter.
textos.IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, no MHF4): aguanta ~30: IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, not MHF4): withstands ~30 mating cycles. The 1.13 mm pigtail loses ~0.5 dB per 10 cm at 2.4 GHz (~0.3 dB at 868 MHz): keep it as short as possible.
textos.IPEX: encima de la placa a 3 mm del bord: IPEX: on top of the board 3 mm from the edge; the minimum ground of the monopoles drops from 12 to 7 mm and the minimum width from 16 to 8 mm. Soldered coax: no connector, with a pad for the live conductor on the line and another for the braid, tied to ground
textos.Impedancia del tramo λ/4 que adapta el d: Impedance of the λ/4 section that matches the dipole to 50 Ω.
textos.Inserción acortada para no partir el par: Feed insertion shortened so as not to split the patch (narrow central neck): the match will be worse; use a lower Minkowski iteration or depth.
textos.Iteración 3 o más: los detalles son pequ: Iteration 3 or more: the details are tiny and the size gain marginal; iteration 2 is usually the best compromise.
textos.Iteración de Koch de los elementos (0 =: Koch iteration of the elements (0 = straight)
textos.Iteración del fractal de Minkowski de ca: Minkowski fractal iteration of each patch (if the element is Minkowski).
textos.Iteración {0}: eficiencia ~30 % y gananc: Iteration {0}: efficiency ~30 % and gain < 1 dBi in simulation (it matches, but hardly radiates); the size estimate is off by 10–40 %. Use iteration 1.
textos.J-pole con el radiador en curva de Koch:: J-pole with the radiator as a Koch curve: shorter for the same frequency.
textos.J-pole con radiador de Koch: sin masa, s: J-pole with Koch radiator: no ground, fed with coax. For a mast.
textos.J-pole recta: casi adapta (−8 a −9 dB);: Straight J-pole: it almost matches (−8 to −9 dB); the Koch J-pole is better.
textos.La GPU ha fallado ({0}): se usa la CPU: The GPU has failed ({0}): the CPU is used
textos.La J-pole no lleva plano de masa: suelda: The J-pole has no ground plane: solder the coax to the tap pads (live conductor to the long arm, braid to the short one) and take it downwards, along the axis of the adapter.
textos.La J-pole recta resuena donde toca pero: The straight J-pole resonates where it should but barely matches (−8 to −9 dB at 2.4 GHz and 868 MHz in simulation): moving the tap does not fully fix it. The Koch J-pole matches better.
textos.La alimentación va por un extremo: los t: The feed is at one end: the far sections receive less current, so going beyond 4–5 sections hardly gains anything.
textos.La altura de la toma ajusta la impedanci: The tap height adjusts the impedance: raise it if the S11 lies in the low-impedance region of the Smith chart and lower it if it lies in the high-impedance one.
textos.La antena sale este % más larga (frecuen: The antenna comes out this % longer (lower frequency) and the silkscreen marks where to cut to raise it.
textos.La antena sale este % por debajo y las m: The antenna comes out this % lower and the marks show where to cut
textos.La banda va de {0:g} a {1:g} MHz: centra: The band goes from {0:g} to {1:g} MHz: centre the antenna at {2:g} MHz, not at {3:g} MHz.
textos.La cara superior tiene {0} piezas de cob: The top face has {0} separate pieces of copper
textos.La disposición simétrica con cruce no co: The symmetric layout with crossing does not correct the beam tilt and worsens the match (−10 dB versus −15.7 dB for the normal one). «All equal» is better.
textos.La frecuencia salta varios % con pequeño: The frequency jumps several % with small changes in height (mesh noise with the meander): the tuning may need more iterations. With a small ground it may not reach −10 dB.
textos.La línea de la simulación aparece cuando: The simulation line appears when the design is saved, unchanged and simulated.
textos.La primera vez descarga unos 15 MB; desp: The first time it downloads about 15 MB; afterwards it stays in the browser cache. Everything is computed in your browser: nothing is sent to any server.
textos.La rama es demasiado corta para el cruce: The branch is too short for the strip crossing: increase the spacing.
textos.La ranura ahorra la cola del transformad: The slot saves the transformer tail (~λg/4 under the patch)
textos.La red pierde ~{0:.1f} dB: con este sust: The network loses ~{0:.1f} dB: with this substrate the large array compensates little compared with a smaller one.
textos.La resonancia está un {0:+.1f} % desviad: The resonance is {0:+.1f} % off and this antenna has no cut/section margin: correct it with the π network or redesign.
textos.La resonancia ya está en la frecuencia o: The resonance is already at the target frequency.
textos.La separación placa–reflector ajusta la: The board–reflector spacing tunes the impedance: measure and, if needed, change the length of the spacers (±2–3 mm) before touching anything else.
textos.La simulación NO cubre la banda entera: The simulation does NOT cover the whole band
textos.La simulación terminó sin resultado (mir: The simulation ended without a result (see the console).
textos.La toma suele estar entre el 10 y el 40: The tap is usually between 10 and 40 % of the adapter for 50 Ω.
textos.La εr del FR4 de JLC está pendiente de m: The εr of JLC's FR4 is still to be measured with the coupon: the real frequency can move ±2–3 %.
textos.Lado del cuadrado que ocupa la curva. Fi: Side of the square occupied by the curve. It sets the frequency: larger means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo (entre ex: Length of each dipole arm (between ends) [mm]
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo. Fija la: Length of each dipole arm. It sets the frequency: longer means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada elemento de media onda: fi: Length of each half-wave element: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada parche: fija la frecuencia: Length of each patch: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada tramo de media onda: fija: Length of each half-wave section: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de la CPS sobre la masa [mm]: Length of the CPS over the ground [mm]
textos.Largo de la línea de 50 Ω desde el conec: Length of the 50 Ω line from the connector to the antenna.
textos.Largo de la línea de dos tiras: también: Length of the two-strip line: it also adjusts the match.
textos.Largo de las aletas: más largo, más gana: Length of the fins: longer, more gain and more bandwidth, and a longer board.
textos.Largo del 1.er director (fracción del di: Length of the 1st director (fraction of the dipole)
textos.Largo del balun impreso (la tira central: Length of the printed balun (the central strip): separates the antenna from the connector.
textos.Largo del parásito (fracción del largo): Length of the parasitic (fraction of the length)
textos.Largo del parásito respecto al del parch: Length of the parasitic relative to the patch (slightly below 1 widens the band).
textos.Largo del plano de masa cuando es manual: Ground plane length when manual. Below λ/4 the frequency rises and the radiator must be lengthened.
textos.Largo del primer director respecto al di: Length of the first director relative to the dipole. Shorter than the dipole so that it directs forwards.
textos.Largo del radiador: fija la frecuencia (: Radiator length: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
Reflector length relative to the dipole. Longer than the dipole so that it reflects forwards.
textos.Largo resonante del parche: fija la frec: Resonant length of the patch: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
textos.Las bowtie casi se tocan en vertical: su: The bowties almost touch vertically: increase the spacing or close the aperture.
textos.Las muescas de Minkowski reducen el parc: The Minkowski notches shrink the patch by 10–25 % at the cost of bandwidth; the notch depth is the parameter with the most influence.
textos.Las pérdidas de la red crecen con el tam: Network losses grow with size: on FR4, a 4×4 at 2.4 GHz loses ~3.5 dB. For large arrays or at 5.8 GHz, consider RO4350B.
textos.Las ramas de la red son más cortas que e: The network branches are shorter than the 70.7 Ω λ/4: increase the spacing.
textos.Las vueltas de la pista se pisan ({0:.0f: The turns of the track overlap ({0:.0f} % of the area): the curve is too dense for that width; lower the iteration/order, narrow the track or enlarge the antenna

textos.Lo habitual es 0,15–0,25 λ0; en λ0 para: The usual value is 0.15–0.25 λ0; in λ0 so that it does not shrink with Koch elements
textos.Los dipolos casi se tocan en la direcció: The dipoles almost touch in the direction of their arms: increase the spacing.
textos.Los dipolos se tocan: el tramo de línea: The dipoles touch: the line section is shorter than the two arms. Lengthen the section or shorten the arms.
textos.Los directores apuntan hacia donde quier: The directors point where you want the gain. More directors: more gain and a narrower beam, but a longer board and slightly less bandwidth.
textos.Los recortes de aligerado no se han simu: The lightening cut-outs have not been simulated yet: removing FR4 raises the frequency a little. Simulate it before manufacturing.

textos.Línea de 50 Ω entre el conector y el pri: 50 Ω line between the connector and the first dipole.
textos.Línea de 50 Ω hasta las aletas [mm]: 50 Ω line up to the fins [mm]

textos.Marcas de corte rotuladas con la simulac: Cut marks labelled with the simulation (×{0:.4f} over the estimate)
textos.Marco del borde, nervio central y nervio: Edge frame, central rib and ribs that split the long windows
textos.Margen de la placa alrededor del cobre (: Board margin around the copper (leaves room for the corner holes).
textos.Masa de {0:.0f} mm, el {1:.0f} % de λ/4:: Ground of {0:.0f} mm, {1:.0f} % of λ/4: less efficiency and bandwidth, and the cable becomes part of the antenna (use a ferrite when measuring).
textos.Masa de {0:.0f} mm, menos de λ/4: el cab: Ground of {0:.0f} mm, less than λ/4: the cable becomes part of the antenna (ferrite when measuring).
textos.Medidas secundarias pasadas a «Manuales»: Secondary dimensions switched to «Manual» to respect the value you entered.
textos.Menos peso y algo menos de pérdidas; qui: Less weight and slightly less loss; removing FR4 raises the frequency a little: simulate again
textos.Microstrip por el boom; medio dipolo en: Microstrip along the boom; half a dipole on each face (the line acts as the balun), reflector on the bottom face joined to ground and 0–8 directors, separate or joined to the boom. Straight or Koch elements. Narrow, long board; gain ~4.5–11 dBi.
textos.Mide con la antena apuntando a un espaci: Measure with the antenna pointing at an open space: an object in front, closer than ~1 m, changes the match.
textos.Mide con la antena vertical y lejos de m: Measure with the antenna vertical and away from tables or metal walls: it is long and anything nearby affects it.
textos.Minkowski de iteración 3 en el array: lo: Minkowski iteration 3 in the array: the necks may fall below the manufacturing rules.
textos.Monopolo fractal de Koch: más compacto q: Koch fractal monopole: more compact than the straight one, with good bandwidth. Recommended.
textos.Monopolo λ/4 plegado en «F»: brazo horiz: λ/4 monopole folded into an «F»: horizontal arm parallel to the ground, fed by a tap and shorted to ground with a via. Compact and low. Not validated.
textos.Monopolo λ/4 sobre masa seguido de eleme: λ/4 monopole over ground followed by λ/2 elements joined by λ/4 hairpins that invert the phase. One face; omnidirectional, ~4–6 dBi. The hairpins widen the board.
textos.Multibanda con bandas a razón ~2 (la ape: Multiband with bands in a ratio of ~2 (the triangle aperture shifts them). 868 MHz and 2.4 GHz are in a ratio of 2.8: they do not fit the classic Sierpinski.
textos.Más ancho: más ancho de banda (y dipolo: Wider: more bandwidth (and a slightly shorter dipole)
textos.Más grosor de sustrato da más ancho de b: A thicker substrate gives more bandwidth and efficiency; on 1.6 mm FR4 a patch at 2.4 GHz has about 2–3 % bandwidth and 50–70 % efficiency.
textos.Más hueco: acoplo más débil; menos: más: More gap: weaker coupling; less: more coupling and more bandwidth
textos.Más tasa: la aleta se abre más tarde y d: More rate: the fin opens later and abruptly
textos.Nivel del Sierpinski de cada brazo (solo: Sierpinski level of each arm (only with «Sierpinski bowtie»). More iterations: more gaps and an electrically longer arm.
Sierpinski level of each arm (only with «Sierpinski bowtie»). More iterations: more gaps, an electrically longer arm and slightly less bandwidth.
textos.Nivel del fractal. Más iteración: antena: Fractal level. More iterations: more compact antenna, but less bandwidth and slightly less efficiency. 0 = no fractal (straight). Usually 1–2.
textos.No caben en la serigrafía:: They do not fit in the silkscreen:
textos.No dependen de la placa a la que se cone: They do not depend on the board they are connected to: good for a mast or away from the equipment.

textos.No llega a −10 dB cerca del objetivo (mí: It does not reach −10 dB near the target (minimum {0:.1f} dB): poor match; resonance by {1}.

textos.No pongas cobre fuera del plano de masa: Do not put copper outside the ground plane (dipole and director area) on either face.

textos.Número de dipolos en serie. Más dipolos:: Number of dipoles in series. More dipoles: more gain and a longer board (4 at 2.4 GHz: ~26 cm).
textos.Número de directores (elementos delante: Number of directors (elements in front of the dipole). More directors: more gain and a narrower beam, but a longer board.
textos.Número de elementos de media onda sobre: Number of half-wave elements on the base. More elements: more gain and a longer antenna.
textos.Número de elementos: 1 = uno solo sobre: Number of elements: 1 = a single one over the reflector (no network, ~7–9 dBi), 2 = 2×2 (4 elements) and 4 = 4×4 (16, ~4–5 dB more and a board 4 times larger).
textos.Número de elementos: 2 = 2×2 (4 elemento: Number of elements: 2 = 2×2 (4 elements), 4 = 4×4 (16 elements, ~4–5 dB more and a board 4 times larger).
textos.Número de idas y vueltas del zigzag. Más: Number of back-and-forth runs of the zigzag. More turns: lower antenna, but less bandwidth.
textos.Número de tramos. Más tramos: más gananc: Number of sections. More sections: more gain in theory and a longer antenna.
textos.Omnidireccional con el haz aplastado hac: Omnidirectional with the beam squashed towards the horizon: more sections or elements, more gain but a narrower vertical beam and a narrower band. Mount it vertically.
textos.Orden de la curva de Hilbert: cada orden: Hilbert curve order: each extra order folds the track more and shrinks the antenna, at the cost of a worse match and slower simulations.
textos.PIFA: F invertida con brazo ancho, más b: PIFA: inverted-F with a wide arm, more bandwidth. Not validated.
textos.Panel con bowtie liso: en simulación ada: Panel with plain bowtie: in simulation it matches more erratically than with straight dipoles or Sierpinski bowties (2.4 GHz).
textos.Panel de un solo elemento: el S11 salta: Single-element panel: S11 jumps a lot with the arm length and with the reflector (it resonates far from the target with the default size). Simulate and tune it before manufacturing.
textos.Para medir con el NanoVNA hace falta un: To measure with the NanoVNA you need an IPEX–SMA pigtail: measure it first with vna/medir_latiguillo.py and subtract its delay, or the apparent frequency shifts.
textos.Para medir la ganancia relativa, compara: To measure relative gain, compare with a straight reference monopole at the same distance.
textos.Para probar y aprender: tienen problemas: To try out and learn: they have known problems.
textos.Parche alargado {0:.1f} %: corta en para: Patch lengthened by {0:.1f} %: cut parallel to the top edge at the mark for the desired frequency.
textos.Parche casi cuadrado con dos esquinas op: Almost square patch with two opposite corners cut and a single feed: the polarisation comes out circular (GPS, Iridium). Not tested or validated.
textos.Parche con parásito acoplado (alternativ: Patch with coupled parasitic (flat alternative to stacked)
textos.Parche con parásito acoplado (más banda): Patch with coupled parasitic (more bandwidth), on the same face. Not validated.
textos.Parche con ranura en U: más banda que el: Patch with U-slot: more bandwidth than the rectangular one. Not validated.
textos.Parche con un segundo parche acoplado po: Patch with a second patch coupled along the radiating edge, on the same face: more bandwidth than the simple one. A real stacked patch needs a second board. Not validated.
textos.Parche cuadrado con bordes de Minkowski:: Square patch with Minkowski edges: smaller than the rectangular one.
textos.Parche de polarización circular con una: Circularly polarised patch with a single feed (GPS, Iridium). Not tested or validated.
textos.Parche fractal de Minkowski: más pequeño: Minkowski fractal patch: smaller than the rectangular one, but it loses more.
Microstrip patch with λ/4 transformer. Directional (~6 dBi).
textos.Parche rectangular con una ranura en U:: Rectangular patch with a U-slot: more bandwidth than the normal one (up to ~3 times). Not validated.
textos.Parche sobre plano de masa: algo directi: Patch over a ground plane: somewhat directional (~5 dBi) and narrow band.
textos.Parches rectangulares o de Minkowski con: Rectangular or Minkowski patches with an in-phase corporate network. 2×2 ≈ 10–11 dBi and 4×4 ≈ 15–17 dBi ideal, minus the network losses (estimated).
textos.Parámetros ajustados aplicados. Guarda e: Tuned parameters applied. Save the design to keep them.
textos.Pasa el dieléctrico; 1,7 mm para RG-316: The dielectric passes through; 1.7 mm for RG-316 / RG-174
textos.Pasillo entre filas de {0:.1f} mm: muy j: Gap between rows of {0:.1f} mm: very tight for the phase U; increase the spacing between patches.
textos.Pedido, fecha de fabricación, qué se cor: Order, manufacturing date, what was cut, results…
textos.Pendiente de validación (poca ganancia e: Pending validation (low gain on FR4; useless at 868 MHz)
textos.Plano de masa que sobresale alrededor de: Ground plane that protrudes around the patch. Below ~λ/20 the backward radiation increases.
textos.Plano de masa, que hace de reflector det: Ground plane, which acts as a reflector behind the dipole.
textos.Pon la CARGA de 50 Ω al final del latigu: Fit the 50 Ω LOAD at the end of the patch cable. When well calibrated, |S11| is below −30 dB.
textos.Pon una ferrita (o unas vueltas del coax: Fit a ferrite (or a few turns of the coax) just under the tap: without a choke, the braid radiates and shifts the resonance.
textos.Por el borde, con transformador λ/4: From the edge, with λ/4 transformer
textos.Por el borde: la línea llega al borde de: From the edge: the line reaches the patch edge with a λ/4 transformer (longer). Slot: the line enters the patch up to the 50 Ω point (more compact).
textos.Por encima de ~3 GHz el FR4 pierde basta: Above ~3 GHz the FR4 loses a lot and its εr varies between batches: consider RO4350B.
textos.Por ranura (inset) hasta el punto de 50: By slot (inset) up to the 50 Ω point
textos.Prevé una red en π (huellas 0402/0603: s: Plan a π network (0402/0603 footprints: series + two to ground) next to the feed to tune the match once manufactured.
textos.Profundidad de la ranura de alimentación: Depth of the feed slot inside the patch. 0 = the program computes it for 50 Ω.
textos.Profundidad de la ranura desde el borde: Slot depth from the patch edge [mm] (0 = estimated)
textos.Profundidad de la ranura en U, como frac: Depth of the U-slot, as a fraction of the patch length.
textos.Profundidad de las muescas del fractal d: Depth of the Minkowski fractal notches (fraction of a third of the side). Deeper: smaller patch for the same frequency.
textos.Punta de flecha de Sierpinski: una pista: Sierpinski arrowhead: one trace that fills a triangle. A curiosity, not validated.
textos.Punto donde se suelda el coaxial; más ar: Point where the coax is soldered; higher = more impedance
textos.Pérdidas a 5,8 GHz: el FR4 de JLC (tanδ: Losses at 5.8 GHz: JLC's FR4 (tanδ 0.02) loses around 0.1 dB per cm of line and the antenna efficiency drops noticeably; in arrays and panels, the feed network can add several dB. With RO4350B the losses are much lower.
textos.Quasi-Yagi con dipolo de Koch: radia hac: Quasi-Yagi with Koch dipole: radiates backwards in simulation.
textos.Radia (D 4,7 dBi) pero las pérdidas del: It radiates (D 4.7 dBi) but the FR4 losses leave the efficiency at ~53 % and the gain at ~1.9 dBi: the collinear gain is not noticeable. At 868 MHz it is worse (η 26 %, −2 dBi, S11 −7.8 dB): do not use it there.
textos.Radia hacia atrás (hacia el reflector) y: Radiates backwards (towards the reflector) and matches poorly (−3.5 dB) in simulation. Experimental: do not manufacture it yet.
textos.Radia hacia el lado del parche: no lo ta: Radiates towards the patch side: do not cover it with metal or stick it to the case.
textos.Radiador λ/2 con adaptador λ/4 de tiras: λ/2 radiator with parallel-strip λ/4 adapter; no ground plane. Fed with coax soldered at the tap point.
textos.Radian en todas direcciones: para nodos: They radiate in all directions: for Meshtastic nodes, trackers and equipment that moves. Compact.
textos.Rayas en la serigrafía con la frecuencia: Lines on the silkscreen with the frequency, in MHz, left after cutting at each one.
textos.Recortes: no cabe ninguna ventana con es: Cut-outs: no window fits with that margin and that rib.

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. With the SMA connector, the ground sleeve is the second arm; the cable can radiate if the sleeve is short (use a ferrite when measuring).

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. The arm length and the distance from the tap to the short are not calibrated; the tap sets the impedance and must be tuned by simulating.

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. The mouth size and the opening rate are not calibrated; the transition from the line to the fins may need tuning. At 868 MHz the board comes out very large.

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. It is a parasitic coupled on the same face, not a real stack (which would need a second board). The gap and the parasitic length are not calibrated.

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. The gain from stacking dipoles is partly eaten by the FR4 losses in the microstrip sections (~0.05 dB/cm at 2.4 GHz); with many dipoles the gain stops growing. The board is long. The real coaxial cable lying along the board is not modelled: in the simulation the feed is the line from the edge.
Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. The U-slot widens the band, but its size and position are not calibrated and shift the frequency: simulate and tune.

Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. Neither the size nor the corner cut is calibrated, and the axial ratio and the sense of rotation have not been checked (GPS and Iridium are right-handed). The circular polarisation holds only over a very small bandwidth and FR4 (εr ±2–3 %) detunes it easily.
Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. On a 1.6 mm board, the wide arm gives more bandwidth than the thin inverted-F, but the size and the tap are not calibrated.
